source_semantics.control: The source CurrentUserChip exposes Connect your first site only when the current tenant has zero sites.
source_semantics.read_only: The chip control only navigates to the existing connect workspace; it does not create, pair, or mutate a site itself.

laravel_adaptation.frontend: resources/js/current-user-connect-site-control.tsx reads the authoritative tenant sites endpoint and renders the exact canonical link into the real .user-chip only after an empty array is confirmed.
laravel_adaptation.read_authority: GET /api/tenants/{tenant}/sites is the existing tenant-scoped SiteManagementController index contract and the control fails closed for read failure or malformed payload.
laravel_adaptation.destination: SitesConnectRouteServiceProvider registers explicit /tenants/{tenant}/sites/connect before the SPA fallback and requires tenant.view plus sites.manage.
laravel_adaptation.guard: The link is suppressed when an active site exists, sites.manage is missing, the sites API is absent, the tenant has any site, or the authoritative read cannot be trusted.

proofs: exact canonical PENDING operation identity and CurrentUserChip source
production operation marker on the real zero-sites CurrentUserChip destination
explicit authenticated tenant-scoped connect workspace guarded by sites.manage
authoritative empty/non-empty tenant sites reads drive visibility without mutation
guest, permission and foreign-tenant paths fail closed
malformed, unavailable, or failed site reads never render fake availability
